abstract: We have studied 2 cases of nonfamilial male pseudohermaphroditism by persistent müllerian ducts. The first case, found in a fourteen-year-old male, can be described as the classic form of cryptorchism which resisted hormonal treatment and in which a rudimentary uterus with fallopian tubes and atrophic testicles were found at exploratory laparotomy. The second case was discovered in a thirty-nine-year-old man who had bilateral cryptorchism. He presented with an abdominal mass which was found to be a seminoma in the right intra-abdominal testicle, and a well-defined uterus with fallopian tubes and an atrophic left testicle were seen. Neither case presented phenotype disturbances. Both karyotypes were 46 XY. A total resection of the female sexual organs and testicles was performed in both patients, and the mass was removed in the second case. The tumoral degeneration of the intra-abdominal testicles in this syndrome is found in similar proportion to the simple cryptorchid testicles. Our second case is the tenth one of a testicular tumor in pseudohermaphroditism by persistent müllerian ducts to be reported in the literature.
abstract_ja: 我々は、非家族性の持続性ミュラー管による男性仮性半陰陽の2症例を検討した。第1症例は14歳男性で、ホルモン治療に抵抗性を示す典型的な停留精巣の型であり、開腹探索術で未発達な子宮と卵管、および萎縮精巣が認められた。第2症例は両側停留精巣を有する39歳男性で、腹腔内の右側精巣に腫瘤が認められ、セミノーマであることが判明した。また、明瞭な子宮と卵管、および萎縮した左精巣が認められた。両症例とも表現型の異常は認められなかった。両者とも核型は46,XYであった。両患者に対して女性生殖器および精巣の全切除が施行され、第2症例では腫瘤も摘出された。本症候群における腹腔内精巣の腫瘍化は、単純な停留精巣と同程度の割合で認められる。本症例は、持続性ミュラー管による仮性半陰陽における精巣腫瘍の、文献上10例目の報告である。
